title: I picked this over a standard couch.
text:
I picked this over a standard couch.. I moved into a small apartment and I knew I would be lounging but also potentially moving within the next year. So here I am.

Points to keep in mind: I've had this for 1.5 months, don't know a true durability, and I bought the extra 10lb foam bag. It took about 10 days total for it to fully fluff up, but that's probably because of the added foam.

Pros:
1) it's huge. Yes, 7'5. I can fit in it comfortably at 5'6 with a pillow and blanket and still have plenty of room. So far we have fit 2 adults and a toddler but horizontally and vertically and I want to say it still might fit another adult, snuggly.
2) it can take a bit of a couch shape if you prop it up against a wall and then sit on it.
3) super versatile as far as what to use it for

Cons:
1) it flattens..you do have to rotate it and fluff it up from time to time. But it's not a huge deal tbh
2) it's huge. It came in a 2x2x2 box, but I have no idea how I'm going to transport this later.

product_metadata.title: Chill Sack Memory Foam Bean Bag Lounger, 7.5-Feet, Brown Pebble
features: Super soft micro suede cover that can be removed and washed
Ultra durable inner liner with child safety zipper
Made in the USA by Chill Sack
Dimensions: 34" H x 90" W x 48" D
description: Our 7.5 foot bean bag lounger is the ultimate lounger for someone looking for the comfort of a Chill Sack but also the versatility of a couch or futon. Due to its large size, the 7.5 foot bean bag lounger can easily fit 3-4 people (like a couch) and can also be used as a awesome bed (like a futon). The 7.5 ft. lounger is the largest lounger offered on the market and will become your new favorite place to kick back and relax. We call them bean bag furniture, but you’ll find no beans or Styrofoam pellets here. Just the softest, furniture quality shredded foam for a totally unique lounging experience.
